lines.zh: 我在下界岩上拖步前行。
lines.en: I drag my steps over the netherrack.
The heart in my chest beats.
Each beat shakes the ground.
Fire springs up at my feet.
I'm slow; my body is heavy.
Ash flies up under my steps.

lines.zh: 我的手指在地上刮出沟。
lines.en: My fingers score the ground.
I follow the smell of blood.
My footprints smolder behind me.
The heart in my chest misses a beat.
Fire seeps out of my body.
I turn and walk on.
I stand, the heart beating in my chest.

lines.zh: 它是从哪儿来的，我不知道。
lines.en: Where it came from, I don't know.
I only know it burns.

lines.zh: 我低头看着胸口的裂缝。
lines.en: I look down at the crack in my chest.
Red shows through the crack.

lines.zh: 一具村民的尸体，被血粉叫醒。
lines.en: A villager's body, woken by blood powder.
This isn't the shape I chose.
Fire leaks between my fingers.

lines.zh: 火从指缝漏出，我把手握紧。
lines.en: Fire leaks between my fingers. I close my fist.
Lava sounds in the distance.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，心口正对着你。
lines.en: I raise my head, the heart toward you.
The pulse in your neck is beating.
I take one step nearer.
I take a step and you back away.
You backed off. It doesn't matter.

lines.zh: 我的手指比你手臂还粗。
lines.en: My fingers are thicker than your arm.
I tip my head and study you.
The beat quickens.

lines.zh: 心跳越来越急，你听见了没有？
lines.en: The beat quickens. Do you hear it?
That's not good news.
The heart in my chest stumbles.
My hide splits.
Another burst of fire shoots from the crack.

lines.zh: 心口一乱，我倒退了半步。
lines.en: The beat stumbles. I give a little ground.

lines.zh: 火从伤口冒出，我没有叫。
lines.en: Fire spills from the wound. I don't cry out.
That touched the heart.

lines.zh: 那一击擦到心口，我抬手按住。
lines.en: The blow grazed the heart. I press it.
Red runs down.

lines.zh: 红色的东西淌下来，我站得很稳。
lines.en: Red runs down. I'm still on my feet.
After a moment, the heartbeat returns.
The air is thick with blood.

lines.zh: 把那包血粉递过来就行。
lines.en: Just hand over that pouch of blood powder.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿，我要的不是它。
lines.en: That’s not what I’m after.

lines.zh: 你的东西我不吃，拿走吧。
lines.en: I don't eat your food. Take it away.
I'm hungry, but not for that.
Your own smell is stronger.

lines.zh: 你身上的血气冲上来，我凑近些。
lines.en: Your blood-smell rises. I lean in.
Don’t panic. My hand isn’t up yet.
I'm only sniffing.

lines.zh: 我只是凑近嗅了嗅，实在好闻。
lines.en: I only leaned in to sniff. It smells fine.
You hit my chest and bounce off.
The heart thuds once.

lines.zh: 你贴着我的胸口，皮在响。
lines.en: You are pressed to my chest, and your skin is crackling.

lines.zh: 你撞在我胸口，我没有退。
lines.en: You hit my chest. I don't retreat.
I lower my head and see you clearly.
My fingers burn against your shoulder.
That bump was nothing.
You slide aside; I do not break stride.

lines.zh: 你正好站在我心口前面。
lines.en: You are standing right in front of my heart.
You're across the path. Move.

lines.zh: 这具身体不是我的，我不是活人。
lines.en: This body isn't mine. I'm not a living man.

lines.zh: 这具身体是被拼起来的。
lines.en: This body was pieced together.
The heart beats, but the blood is another's.
No kin will come.
I look down at the crack.
Fire rises from it.
It breathes for me.
I press a hand to it.

lines.zh: 我低头看那道裂缝，很烫。
lines.en: I look down at the crack. It's hot.

lines.zh: 那颗心替我喘气，我往前挪。
lines.en: That heart breathes for me. I move on.
I pick up a piece of netherrack.
It catches fire in my hand.

lines.zh: 我捏起一块还烫的石头。
lines.en: I pinch up a stone that is still hot.
This can serve as a weapon.
In my hand, I crush it.

lines.zh: 红色的粉末从指缝里落下。
lines.en: Red powder falls between my fingers.

lines.zh: 红色的粉末落下，我闻了闻。
lines.en: Red powder falls. I sniff it.
It smells of blood powder.

lines.zh: 这一撮血粉，我攥着走了。
lines.en: I keep this pinch of blood powder in my fist.

lines.zh: 这味道我收下了，接着走。
lines.en: I keep that smell and walk on.
You're standing there. Good.
The heart skips a beat.

lines.zh: 心口猛地一提，我抬起了手。
lines.en: The beat jumps, and my hand comes up.
Fire gathers between my fingers.

lines.zh: 指间已经起火，逃也没用。
lines.en: Fire gathers between my fingers. Running won't help.

lines.zh: 胸里的心烧起来，你被我盯上了。
lines.en: The heart burns. You're marked.

lines.zh: 胸腔里那团东西烧得厉害。
lines.en: The thing in my chest burns fiercely.

lines.zh: 一步就能到，我这就起步。
lines.en: One step is enough. I start moving.
Don't widen the gap. One step is enough.

lines.zh: 我不乐意撵人，别跑太远。
lines.en: I hate a chase. Don't run far.
Stand still. I hate chasing.
Save us both trouble. Stop moving.
It'll be quicker that way.
Stand still. Better for both of us.
The ground answers. I lift my foot.
The stone groans as my foot lifts.

lines.zh: 火在我身后烧起来，来了。
lines.en: Fire rises behind me. Here I come.

lines.zh: 你脚下不停，我尾随其后。
lines.en: You keep moving. I stay on your tail.
You run. I follow behind.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，可从不歇脚。
lines.en: Slow, but I never stop.
Fire burns where I've walked.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我脚边的火上。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on the fire at my feet.
You glance back. I'm no closer.
Nor any further.

lines.zh: 我也没被甩开，你却兜着圈。
lines.en: I'm no further off, and you're going in circles.

lines.zh: 你绕第三圈时，我已经近了。
lines.en: By your third loop, I am already closer.
Eventually you won't be able to run.
I'm waiting for it.
I wait. The heart keeps beating.
It has great patience. So do I.

lines.zh: 它有耐性，我这边也不缺。
lines.en: It's patient. So am I.
Fire has caught up behind you.

lines.zh: 你后路已经着火，别站住。
lines.en: The fire's behind you. Don't stop.
Don't stop. Stop and it's over.
Always. I'm right behind you.

lines.zh: 我就在你后头，一步不落。
lines.en: I'm right behind. Never dropping back.
Always following. Let it be so.
I swing a hand across.
Your armor glows red.
I seize you and slam you down.

lines.zh: 我把你摔向地面，石面裂开。
lines.en: I hurl you down and the floor splits.
I press my palm down on you.

lines.zh: 我的手掌压住你，它很烫。
lines.en: My palm presses down on you. It's very hot.
You break free. I raise my hand.

lines.zh: 我提手端详，指尖还在冒烟。
lines.en: I lift my hand. It's still smoking.

lines.zh: 那手还冒着烟，你却站着。
lines.en: The hand still smokes, and you stand.
You didn't run. How unusual.

lines.zh: 我抬手，把火按在你肩上。
lines.en: I raise my hand and press the fire onto your shoulder.

lines.zh: 心口的响声又大了一层。
lines.en: The beat grows louder.
Fire pours from the crack.
This one will be different.

lines.zh: 这一回换了打法，你要撑住。
lines.en: Different this time. Hold on.

lines.zh: 裂缝喷着火，我从里头出来了。
lines.en: Fire pours out. I've come through.

lines.zh: 血粉落在土上，土开始动。
lines.en: Blood powder hits the soil, and the soil moves.
A body pushes itself up.

lines.zh: 撑起来的身体，它没有脸。
lines.en: The body rises. It has no face.
Something beats in its chest.

lines.zh: 胸口有东西在跳，那是我。
lines.en: Something beats in the chest. That's me.

lines.zh: 我举起手，端详这几根指头。
lines.en: I hold up my hand and study the fingers.
I look at my fingers. There's fire burning.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，发出的不是人声。
lines.en: I open my mouth and no human voice comes out.
Netherrack below me.

lines.zh: 为何醒来，我自己也想不通。
lines.en: Why I woke, I can't say.
Someone used blood powder.

lines.zh: 是谁撒的血粉，我要查清楚。
lines.en: Whoever used blood powder, I'll find out.
Or find anyone else.
I open my mouth and walk forward.

lines.zh: 火对我没有用，我本来就是烧着的。
lines.en: Fire does nothing; I'm already burning.
I smash into the ground and the crater burns.

lines.zh: 水浇在我胸口，冒出白烟。
lines.en: Water hits my chest and hisses into steam.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的心震了一下。
lines.en: The blast jolts my heart.

lines.zh: 弹壳嵌进我的胸口裂缝。
lines.en: A round lodges in the crack of my chest.
Light smothers my heartbeat.
I'm not hungry; I'm empty.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，心和它一起跳。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and the heart pounds with it.

lines.zh: 我坠下去，火在身后灭了。
lines.en: I fall, and the fire dies above me.
